text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A magazine interview, is it? As long as it
doesn't interfere with our training schedule, go ahead.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Could I ask you to wear the Muse outfit?
Yeah. Could you do it in the Muse outfit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They want to feature the strength that won over the Muse alongside the outfit.
Seems to be the concept for the magazine shoot.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I see.
Then could you just send me the date and time?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the same reaction she always gave,
no matter what kind of interview it was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought at the time...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, hoo! Hoo, hoo!
Hoo, hoo, hoo, hoo.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo... ngh...! Not yet, not yet...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Ho-ho-ho.
Perhaps a tea time is in order?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No! I'm still fine!
I won't let the gap widen any further...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Very well. —It must be so.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
With that fierce "hunger"—
keep challenging yourself. My indomitable one.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I shall crush you in a direct confrontation.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's use the thick logs as a frame to build our shelter!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I will hand you a saw, so please cut
the fallen tree into manageable lengths—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: No, that won't be necessary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: For I have the power within me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible... She chopped right through a fallen tree with her bare hand...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So, what's next?
So far, the challenges have all been rather soft.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Would you bestow upon me the severity of nature?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Heheh. Ahahahahaha!
Ha... Hmph!!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Aha――wonderful!
More! I want to savor... more of you...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, n-no... that's not it...
I-I'm so sorry! I... I am...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Please, lay it all bare.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, it won't serve as sustenance for me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Tantalizing, isn't it? A dialogue with the strong.
Come, give me more. —More!
choice_data_list: (W-Wow, what an incredible finishing kick...)
(W-Wow, what an incredible finishing kick...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna had suddenly begun refining herself.
I wondered why she was going to such lengths, but—

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
S-Splendid... It's beyond my wildest imagination!
No matter where or how I shoot, every angle is picture-perfect!!

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
That pose is great too! Just wonderful!
You're the best, Ms. Gentile!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I know.
Because I looked in the mirror.
choice_data_list: (Ahh, I see...)
(Ah, I see...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking at Gentildonna, proudly posing for the shoot in her beautiful racing racewear, it all clicks into place——
choice_data_list: So you were polishing it up for today's shoot, huh!
You polished it up for today's shoot, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: No?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is so that I may don it.
The mantle of the strong.
choice_data_list: To wear...? The racing silks?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Take a good look now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Gorgeous drapes, a graceful tiara.
Above all... hehe, colors so mesmerizing they entrance you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In this color lies an "avidity"
that seeks to steal every gaze in the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—"I will not let the weak wear this."
Doesn't the tailoring exude that kind of resolve?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So, I polished myself. To become someone worthy of it.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I pulled off the look, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead.
You are quite welcome to be mesmerized.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I said, I was captivated for a few brief moments.
And not just by her looks. Down to her very soul,
she was a steadfast and graceful gentlewoman—
choice_data_list: If I'm going to stand beside you, I've got to look the part too
If I'm going to stand beside you, I need to look the part too
It's a wonderful racing outfit! No wonder you like it so much.
It's a wonderful racing outfit! No wonder you like it so much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I said, I was captivated for a few brief moments.
And not just by her looks. Down to her very soul,
she was a steadfast and graceful gentlewoman—
choice_data_list: If I'm going to stand beside you, I've got to look the part too
If I'm going to stand beside you, I need to look the part too
It's a wonderful racing outfit! No wonder you like it so much.
It's a wonderful racing outfit! No wonder you like it so much.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Why not go look for matching outfits sometime?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll make time to go.
Yeah, I'll make time to go.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Call for me when that time comes.
I shall accompany you."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You will choose an item worthy of me, won't you?
Assuming you are truly my Trainer, that is."
choice_data_list: ...I'll put everything I have into meeting your expectations!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I am looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately for you,
I have no interest in clothes that are merely flashy and simple.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It has to be a victory so fierce
it bares its fangs at the strong. Don't you think?"
